column1: # Page coverage per registered system: registry primary_pages against every contract's
# implements: key. OPUS 2026-09-21, answering the S-07 correction's statement that this had
# been done only for S-07 and S-20, which is why every other page-count SCOPE-SHORT call is
# carried there as an UPPER BOUND on the gap.
# THE DASH IN A YAML LIST MUST BE ANCHORED TO ITS LINE. A first run matched a dash anywhere
# in the implements: block; every page name here is hyphenated, so it matched inside
# `the-widget-constructor-and-object-sizes` and dropped the name's first word. That reported
# S-34 and S-36 as uncovered, both of which had been verified covered BY HAND the same day,
# and the disagreement with the hand check is what exposed it.
# implements: IS PROVENANCE, NOT COVERAGE - this measures the key, not the subject. A page
# can be uncovered here and its mechanisms still be contract entries, which is exactly what
# S-34 turned out to be: its second page has no contract implementing it, and both of that
# page's mechanisms are entries of contracts.
